title: Confidence changes how the date reads, not which candidate wins
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset is enrolled on a schedule whose service has more than one active trigger (e.g. a calendar interval and a mileage 'At' target), e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12'.
  3. Open the asset's Maintenance tab (the worklist and a work order's maintenance panel show the same rows).
custom_steps:
1. Compare how a Low-confidence estimate renders against a High-confidence one.
  2. Set two triggers of one service to land on the same day and read the Due cell.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Confidence changes how the date is rendered, never which candidate wins.
  • Where two triggers of one service land on the same day, the Due cell names the one with the higher confidence.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10569 (S12, Due date resolution); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S12; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R6: “Confidence will change how the date is rendered, never which candidate wins”
  • S12-R8: “Where two triggers of one service land on the same day, the Due cell names the one with the higher confidence”
